task.description:
WF-03 Step Final: Merge feature/WF03-GH542-20260807 to main.

Procedure:
1. Verify branch: git branch --show-current (must be feature/WF03-GH542-20260807)
2. Rebase on main: git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main
3. Create PR: gh pr create --base main --title "fix(pg.zig): suppress PostgreSQL error stderr (ISS-0607)" --body "Fixes #542\n\nAdded -Dlog-pg-errors build flag (default false) to gate stderr printing in vendor/pg/pg.zig. Prevents test runner from aborting on negative database tests. Regression test at tests/integration/iss0607_pg_stderr_suppression_test.zig."
4. Merge PR: gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
5. Verify branch deleted: git fetch origin && git branch -r | grep feature/WF03-GH542-20260807 || echo 'Branch deleted'
6. Return to main: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
7. Verify clean state: git status (must show 'nothing to commit, working tree clean')

Return PASS with PR number and merge commit SHA in result.
acceptance_criteria: PR created and merged to main
Local repo on main branch with clean working tree
